Written fresh, informed by the upstream shape adapter. Upstream re-shaped an initialisation checkpoint (truncating the action query bank 32->25, growing the vocabulary by the two event-memory rows); this tool does no re-shaping at all. It validates the four top-level prefixes, refuses any DINO-prefixed tensor, un-shares aliased storage before writing safetensors, and emits a key inventory plus a digest manifest. LEGACY_PREFIX_REMAP is deliberately empty: it is the single place a future attribute rename would land.
